findings.body:
The install-flow smoke test can pass without proving the just-published tag installed.

`npx skills update` picks "the newest matching tag" it can see. If GitHub's tag API still lags past the 5s sleep — or the lockfile hash already matches an older tree — `update` is a no-op, the working tree is unchanged, and this empty-diff branch exits 0 with "already at ${NEW_VERSION}". That is exactly the failure mode pillar (B) claims to catch.

Pin the fetch to the tag Step 3 just pushed, then assert the vendored frontmatter matches before treating empty-diff as success:

```bash
VERSION_NO_V="${NEW_VERSION#v}"
npx --yes skills add "DailybotHQ/ai-diff-reviewer@${NEW_VERSION}" \
  --skill ai-diff-reviewer --force -y
VENDORED_VERSION=$(sed -nE 's/^version:[[:space:]]*"([^"]+)".*/\1/p' \
  .agents/skills/ai-diff-reviewer/SKILL.md | head -n1)
if [ "${VENDORED_VERSION}" != "${VERSION_NO_V}" ]; then
  echo "::error::vendored version ${VENDORED_VERSION} != ${VERSION_NO_V}"
  exit 1
fi
```

(`-y` belongs on `skills add` as well as `npx --yes` — the subcommand has its own interactive agent picker on non-TTY runners.)

Spanish placeholder `mi-repo/` in a consumer-facing layout example.

This repo's own extension (and AGENTS.md Rule #1) escalates non-English text in docs/examples to `warning` — global audience, English only. A copy-paste example is the highest-leverage place for that rule to fire.

Fix in the source-of-truth copy at `skills/ai-diff-reviewer/SKILL.md` (and any parallel `docs/PROMPTS.md` example); do not hand-edit this vendored path (DON'T #14). Suggested replacement:

```suggestion
my-repo/
```

`[Unreleased]` documents Step 3.5 and the first-time vendor, but omits the two behaviour changes consumers (and future us) will actually feel on every PR:

1. New `.review/extension.md` — 17 severity overrides layered on the default prompt.
2. `self-review.yml` now passes `prompt-extension-file: .review/extension.md` on every provider leg.

AGENTS.md Rule #7: runtime/behaviour changes land with a matching CHANGELOG entry. Without these bullets, the next release notes under-describe why self-review started enforcing stdlib-only / `shell=True` / marker rules. Add two short `### Added` bullets above or beside the existing dogfood entries.

Duplicate `**Option A — .review/extension.md**` heading two lines apart — copy-paste leftover. Harmless but sloppy in a file consumers read as the install manual.

Delete one of the two headings in `skills/ai-diff-reviewer/SKILL.md` (source of truth); the vendored copy refreshes on the next release.

"Ran … on `main`" reads as if the vendor command already landed on main before this PR merges. Prefer wording that matches reality, e.g. "Lands with this PR — establishes the vendored baseline Step 3.5 will refresh going forward."

summary:
## Verdict
Solid dogfooding PR — the extension is well-anchored and the self-review wiring is correct — but Step 3.5's smoke test can green without proving the just-published tag installed, and a few Rule #1 / Rule #7 nits need a pass before merge.

## Findings

| # | Severity | File | Summary |
|---|----------|------|---------|
| 1 | ⚠️ warning  | `.github/workflows/auto-release.yml:209` | Soft `skills update` + empty-diff exit can no-op the install smoke test |
| 2 | ⚠️ warning  | `.agents/skills/ai-diff-reviewer/SKILL.md:363` | Spanish `mi-repo/` in example tree (Rule #1) |
| 3 | ⚠️ warning  | `CHANGELOG.md:60` | [Unreleased] omits extension bootstrap + self-review wiring |
| 4 | ℹ️ info     | `.agents/skills/ai-diff-reviewer/SKILL.md:358` | Duplicate `**Option A**` heading |
| 5 | ℹ️ info     | `CHANGELOG.md:82` | "on main" reads as already-landed before this PR merges |

## Notes

- **Extension quality is high.** The 17 severity overrides are concrete and code-anchored (stdlib-only, `shell=True`, `safe_repo_path()`, `_CLI_ENV_ALLOWLIST`, marker contracts, secret logging). Wiring `prompt-extension-file: .review/extension.md` into the self-review matrix is the right local↔CI parity move.
- **Step 3.5 failure surface.** If the step fails after Step 3 has already pushed the tag, Steps 4–5 (release notes + GitHub Release) do not run. The tag still exists; recovery is manual. Worth accepting with eyes open, or moving dogfood after the Release create with `continue-on-error` only if you deliberately want a softer gate.
- **Vendored vs source-of-truth.** The `mi-repo/` / duplicate-heading issues also exist in `skills/ai-diff-reviewer/SKILL.md` (not modified in this PR). Fix the source-of-truth copy; leave `.agents/` alone so DON'T #14 stays intact — Step 3.5 refreshes the vendored tree on the next release.
- **Bootstrap exception.** Hand-adding `.agents/skills/ai-diff-reviewer/**` on this branch is the intentional first-time vendor; DON'T #14 applies to future feature
